Baked Broccoli & Cheese Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, January 2, 2010 - 12:14am

Ingredients




1 bunch broccoli
1 egg
1 cup low fat cottage cheese
1/4 cup chopped onion
1/2 cup shredded cheese (any kind)
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup ground nuts
2 tablespoons oil

Preparation

1 Chop broccoli and steam for 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine egg, cottage cheese, onion and shredded cheese. Season with salt. Grease a shallow baking dish. Pour in broccoli and cover with cheese. Top with ground nuts. Sprinkle oil over nuts. Bake for about 30 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes before serving.
